paite: TOUPA aw, hon sam ding hi ing; ka suangpi, kei lam ah na bil ngongsak ke'n, huchi lou in zaw; nang na hon daihsanleh, kokhuk a lutsukte bang lel in ka hong om kha ding hi.
heading: David La / Panpihna Dia Thumna
english: By David. To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

paite: K'on sap a, ka khutte na biakna mun siangthou lam a ka zakleh, hehpih ka ngetna awte ngaikhia in.
english: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

paite: Migilou-salou lak leh thil hihkhialte lak ah hon kaimangkhawm ke'n; huaite'n a-invengte uh kiang ah lemna thu agen na ua, himahleh alungtangte uah thilhihkhelhna atheh uhi.
english: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.

paite: Athilhih bang zel un, athilhihte leh agitlouhdan bang zel un thuk inla; akhut nasep bang in thuk inla; agitlouh man uh musak in.
english: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

paite: TOUPA nasepte leh akhut a athilhih alimsak louh ziak un ama'n amau bawlhoih lou in ahihse ding hi.
english: Because they don’t respect the works of Yahweh, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

paite: Ama'n ka ngetna awte angaihkhiak ziak in TOUPA phat in om hen.
english: Blessed be Yahweh, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.

paite: TOUPA ka hatna leh ka phaw ahi a; ka lungtang in amah amuang hi; huchi in huh in ka om hi; huaiziak in nakpitak in ka lungtang anuam a; ka la in amah ka phat ding hi.
english: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

paite: TOUPA ahatna uh ahi a, athaunilh a ding in hotdamna insang ahi.
english: Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

paite: Na mite hondam inla, na gouluah ding vualzawl in; amaute vak inla, tangtawn in pom in.
english: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
